label: NOTE: what this set reaches, and the claim it exists for
why: `V92CP::evaluateInfo` and `binaryTable` were read out of .text+0x4f400-0x4f863 in one sitting, so a green t_v92cpeval says our reading and the object agree and not that either is right. THE ENTRIES THAT MATTER MOST are the two bit-order ones: every field but the mask blocks is read least-significant-first and the mask blocks are read most-significant-first (docs/deviations.md D920), and a vector of all ones or all zeros cannot tell those apart. The fills in the driver are what make them separable and these mutations are what prove the fills work. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE REACHES: `word_10c` at or above 15 for case 7 and 9 for case 8, where the decoded mask value overwrites the read cursor itself and the object walks off the object -- docs/deviations.md D922, and a mutation of it would crash rather than be caught.
